title: Bug bash: demo data, personas, shared kit and server modules
story: As the sponsor I want the demo data and personas to tell a coherent story (auto claimant with vehicles, agent with produced policies, sensible dates) and every API the apps call to exist and allow the right roles
acceptance: Every defect assigned to area 'data' is fixed with a regression test, or explained

Each tenant's claimant persona holds a personal auto policy with vehicles and a consistent last name and ZIP; the agent persona produces seeded policies; demo claims have plausible loss and report dates
Audit clean for shared kit and API errors across all personas; full npm test: no new failures
brief: Defect list comes from the audit phase. Do not edit tests/unit/web, tests/unit/adjuster, tests/unit/config (other fixers own them).

verdicts.reason: Independent check on a fresh deployed-config server (port 18705). demo-audit: 20/20 persona screens clean (no console errors, no failed API calls, no raw/empty values); screenshots reviewed (CSR claim view, adjuster claim AUR-2026-000001 with single 90% confidence, humanized cause/status/line, no hidden-AI NBA text; Kestrel claimant start on personal auto with policy prefilled). API: CSR policy search returns policy rows by name, ZIP, prefix and full number in both tenants; agent GET /claims?limit=10&sort=-reportedAt 200 (4 Aurelia, 3 Kestrel) and agent policy search scoped to produced policies; admin GET /config/versions 200; claimant personas hold PA-IL-3644079 (3 vehicles) and PA-MI-1310724 (2 vehicles), policy-vehicles returns them with correct last name+ZIP and 404 with wrong name; policy snapshots populate coverages and vehicles. Demo claims: loss-to-report 0-2 days except deliberate scenarios (12-day theft carries the only fraud score; 8-day prior-loss wind story); every claim insured matches policy. npm test: 1702 tests, 1688 pass, 4 fail; all 4 are tests owned by other tickets that encode behaviour this ticket was required to change (security route snapshot for agent/claimant roles + /integrations/event-types; tests/unit/config/versions-public.test.mjs:50 and tests/ui/claimant.test.mjs:577 Kestrel web channel; tests/ui/csr.test.mjs:520 agent searching a non-produced policy). Requests are posted to security, experience, architecture, platform and quality hubs; these are a scoping gap (IMP-14), not defects. Conditions before sprint close: security reviews and refreshes routes.snapshot.json; S6-BUG-01/02/04 owners update those 3 tests; S6-BUG-02 wires the agent Recent claims panel to GET /claims (it is still empty in the agent desk screenshot even though the API now returns rows).
